conditions.description: Participation is limited to legal entities established in EU Member States, Iceland, Norway, and associated countries: Canada, Israel, Republic of Korea, New Zealand, Switzerland, and the United Kingdom.
Entities controlled by non-eligible countries may be excluded unless guarantees are provided.
Activities are expected to start at TRL 2 and achieve TRL 5 by the end of the project.
Maximum EU contribution per project is €19,000,000. Both the minimum and maximum contributions are set at €19,000,000 (effectively a fixed-amount grant).

conditions.assumption_note: The 48-month maximum is recorded in selected_call.json with an explicit note that it is not stated in the topic text and represents the standard maximum for large RIA actions under Horizon Europe. Verification against Tier 1 normative sources (General Annex B) is required before this is treated as a binding constraint.

conditions.description: Financial support to third parties (FSTP) is applicable with the following limits: maximum per grant at stage 2 of €300,000; maximum per grant at stage 3 of €2,250,000; maximum per third party of €2,550,000.
Standard Horizon Europe RIA minimum consortium composition requirements apply: at least 3 legal entities from 3 different Member States or associated countries.
conditions.assumption_note: The call slice eligibility_conditions field is empty and the curated extract does not specify minimum consortium composition requirements for this topic. The standard Horizon Europe RIA minimum of 3 legal entities from 3 different eligible countries (from General Annex B) is assumed to apply but must be verified against Tier 1 normative sources before use in compliance checking.

conditions.description: Open access to research results and publications is required, consistent with Horizon Europe open science requirements.
conditions.assumption_note: Open access requirements are standard for Horizon Europe RIA actions under the Model Grant Agreement but are not explicitly stated in this topic’s call text or curated extract. This condition is assumed on the basis of the standard Horizon Europe open science mandate; verification against Tier 1 normative sources is required.
